classification.difficultyReason: Combine the angle in a semicircle with triangle angle sums and adjacent angles.

content.prompt: Find the size of both $\angle ABC$ and $\angle ABD$.

spec.description: Cyclic quadrilateral ACBD with diameter AB, an unlabelled centre dot, a leader arrow identifying angle CAB as 18 degrees and angle DAB labelled 68 degrees. Source blue geometry is rendered black under house style; no shading.
spec.mathematics: AB is a diameter; angle CAB = 18 degrees and angle DAB = 68 degrees. All vertices lie on the circle.
spec.answerVisibility: Only given angles are visible; requested answers are omitted.

answer.worked:
Angles in a semicircle give $\angle ACB=\angle ADB=90^\circ$.
$$\begin{aligned}\angle ABC&=180^\circ-90^\circ-18^\circ\\&=72^\circ\\\angle ABD&=180^\circ-90^\circ-68^\circ\\&=22^\circ\end{aligned}$$

spec.description: Circle with A at the top, B at the bottom, C at lower right and D at right; chords AB, AC, AD, BC and BD. Diameter AB contains an unlabelled centre dot. Separate leader arrows identify angles BAC and CAD. Source blue geometry is rendered black under house style; no shading.
spec.mathematics: AB is a diameter; angle BAC = 20 degrees and angle CAD = 25 degrees, so angle BAD = 45 degrees.
spec.answerVisibility: Only 20 degrees and 25 degrees are supplied; requested angles are omitted.

answer.worked:
Angles in a semicircle give $\angle ACB=\angle ADB=90^\circ$.
$$\begin{aligned}\angle ABC&=180^\circ-90^\circ-20^\circ\\&=70^\circ\\\angle BAD&=20^\circ+25^\circ\\&=45^\circ\\\angle ABD&=180^\circ-90^\circ-45^\circ\\&=45^\circ\end{aligned}$$

spec.description: Circle with A at upper left, B at lower right, C at the bottom and D at left; chords AB, AC, AD, BC and BD. Diameter AB contains an unlabelled centre dot. Leader arrows identify angles CAB and DBC. Source blue geometry is rendered black under house style; no shading.
spec.mathematics: AB is a diameter; angle CAB = 18 degrees and angle DBC = 37 degrees. BD lies inside angle ABC.
spec.answerVisibility: Only 18 degrees and 37 degrees are supplied; requested angles are omitted.

answer.worked:
$\angle ACB=90^\circ$ because it is an angle in a semicircle.
$$\begin{aligned}\angle ABC&=180^\circ-90^\circ-18^\circ\\&=72^\circ\\\angle ABD&=72^\circ-37^\circ\\&=35^\circ\end{aligned}$$
